long_description:
Join us in Seattle for a fun Bollywood dance workshop with Nikhil—let’s dance and chill!

About this Event

Bollywood Workshop with Nikhil (Seattle)Get ready to dance and have a blast at our in-person Bollywood Workshop with the amazing Nikhil right here in Seattle! Whether you’re a beginner or a pro, come join us for some fun. Don’t miss out on this chance to learn authentic Bollywood dance steps and make new friends!
About Nikhil:
Nikhil Teja Achi has been dancing since he was six years old. He started with Tollywood and Bollywood dance until 2014, and then he was introduced to hip hop, house, locking, Afro, dancehall, and various other styles through his collegiate dance crew. After completing his bachelor’s, he pursued his interest in street styles by training in various forms in India.
